partition_rule: Each returned partition must be smaller than 1000 and match its selected count; union must match total count and contain no duplicate codes. Derive partitions from current security master, never assume a fixed prefix list is exhaustive.
ma_input: Forward-adjusted close; actual exchange trading dates only; insufficient-history stocks excluded from the corresponding MA denominator.
midday_data: Completed morning bars only; session close at 11:30; morning sum of bar volume and amount; reference previous close inferred and cross-checked in samples.
historical_intraday_ifind_mcp: Not supported by the tested current-day high-frequency interface.
